Composing HTML with partials

+

+ When your output is HTML, partials compose it: a + {t("{{> styles}}")} partial holds the CSS once and a + {t("{{> card}}")} partial is the markup for one row, while the + section just iterates. Mustache stays logic-less — the partials carry the + structure and the style. (This is the one example that previews as HTML in + the Lab rather than plain text.) +
